title: Reference benchmark audit - our Joints lesson against the respiratory reference
statusReason: Both experiences were run end to end as a learner, measured, and compared category by category. Every deliverable in the brief exists. No product file was modified.

ours.entry: no landing screen - the film autoplays on load

reference.title: The Journey of a Breath
reference.entry: loading card, then a landing card with Start lesson / Explore the model
reference.voice: en-IN-Chirp3-HD-Aoede (Google Cloud TTS) - the same voice our build uses
reference.shipping: one HTML document, one ~130 KB inline script

keyFindings: The reference says twice as much per second and changes the picture half as often.
Its scene length is derived from its narration length (speechMs + minMs); ours authors durationMs and fits narration to it.
It writes two separate texts per scene - a short fixed caption and a longer spoken script shown as a subtitle; our caption IS the script.
It glosses exactly the five hard words, inside the label, at the moment the structure appears (Pharynx / THROAT).
It gives a reason in 5 of 13 scenes; we give one in 2 of 36 captions.
It has one spine (a journey); our four categories are interchangeable and nothing carries the learner between them.
Our hinge chapter is 35% of the lesson and is the only category that answers why it is that kind of joint; fixed gets 14 s.
It hides its controls while teaching (class="controls hidden"); we show 15 persistent elements for all 280 s.
It has no assessment, no manipulation and no guided task; we have all three, and they are our strongest teaching.
Under the same throttled rendering, the reference stayed in real time and our film ran at 0.125x - our clock is frame-driven with a 100 ms dt clamp (src/engine/core/RenderLoop.ts:81).
risksToVerifyNext: Autoplay: our film starts with no user gesture. Autoplay was permitted in this browser pane (verified new Audio().play() resolves with navigator.userActivation.hasBeenActive === false), so narration was heard here. NOT verified on a stock Chrome/Safari profile, where the default policy would block it and the learner would watch 4:40 in silence.
The film clock desynchronises from narration audio below ~10 fps. Step 12's emulated phone misses are still open and no real Android device has been measured.
ourObservedStrengths: validated manipulable elbow (single DOF, 0-145, fitted axis, drag or slider, arrow keys)
guided task with a pass condition (bend to 90 degrees, Check my pose)
five-question retrieval challenge phrased by movement, not by name
movement-based classification as the teaching goal
universal explore architecture across four joints with film handoff and resume
schematic honesty system (TEACHING SIMULATION / 3D JOINT MODEL / DRAFT / Sources dialog)
elbow anatomical detail including the fitted axis, capsule and ligaments
accessibility foundation: role=img stage with per-shot description, aria-live, landmarks, 0 axe violations over 24 states, 341 measured contrast runs, reduced motion across 40 shots, reflow to 320 px
keyboard interaction with the subject itself
